description: Chunks iterables into bounded batches using max item count and optional max byte budget per batch.

library_notes.general: Single responsibility — one widget does one thing. No global state. No project-specific code, hardcoded paths, credentials, or environment-specific values. All dependencies must be declared in widget.json tech_stack.dependencies. Examples must run and exit cleanly with no user input, no network calls, and no external dependencies. Do not modify library_notes — it is managed by Cartograph and will be restored on checkin.
library_notes.language: Use pytest for all tests — no unittest. Type hints required on all public functions. No __init__.py in tests/. No if __name__ == '__main__' blocks in src/ files. Imports ordered: stdlib, third-party, local.
